subject: Scheduling: Dedicated capacity sizing call
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@safetyfirst.de>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@safetyfirst.de>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Anna / Carlos,

Thanks again for the discovery call this morning — really appreciate the context on your agent use cases and the latency constraints for interactive workflows. Quick recap and next steps: 

- Current traffic shape: mix of chat + completion calls from agents, peak concurrency ~120 requests, avg payload ~600 tokens.
- Primary goal: keep median p95 latency under 250ms for interactive agent responses while controlling per-token costs.
- Key questions for sizing: model family you plan to use in prod, expected concurrency profile during daytime peaks, and any hard limits on GPU tenancy (SLA/compliance).

We should schedule a dedicated capacity sizing session (technical deep-dive) with one of our infra engineers to align on throughput and latency, go over batching/caching strategies, and propose a Dedicated capacity configuration. Suggested attendees: you + your infra lead, me, and our capacity engineer (Dylan).

Would any of these times work for a 60-minute call next week?
- Tue 2027-04-05 10:00–11:00 CEST
- Wed 2027-04-06 14:00–15:00 CEST
- Thu 2027-04-07 09:00–10:00 CEST

I can also send a short template for estimated request patterns if helpful (example attached).

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
(attachment: safetyfirst_capacity_estimate.xlsx)

From: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@safetyfirst.de>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@safetyfirst.de>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 10:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the summary, that captures it well. Wed 14:00–15:00 CEST on 2027-04-06 works best for us. I'll loop in our infra lead (Carlos is already cc'd) — he'll bring the traffic/slo numbers.

A couple quick answers to your sizing questions:
- Model: likely to start on an open Llama-3-70B variant (quantized) for the first phase; we may evaluate a smaller 33B for lower-cost flows.
- Peak concurrency: ~120 concurrent user-facing requests; backing batch jobs add another ~30 requests during hourly sync windows.
- Hard limits: we'd prefer Dedicated capacity in eu-central region and need SOC2-related audit logs (we'll share checklist separately).

See you then — please send calendar invite.

Best,
Anna
Senior Product Manager | SafetyFirst GmbH

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@safetyfirst.de>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@safetyfirst.de>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 11:20:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Great — thanks Anna. I've invited Dylan to the thread to lead the technical deep-dive. Draft agenda for the 60-minute call:

1) Quick intros & goals (5 min)
2) Review traffic profile and target SLOs (10 min)
3) Model selection & quantization implications (10 min)
4) Serving topology (dedicated pools, autoscale, region choices) (15 min)
5) Batching/caching and kernel/quantization tradeoffs (15 min)
6) Next steps / action items (5 min)

I've added a provisional calendar invite for Wed 2027-04-06 14:00–15:00 CEST (link below). Can you confirm attendees? Also, if you can share a short CSV (or the template I attached) with sample qps by minute and distribution across model types, that will help us run a sizing exercise ahead of the call.

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=abcd1234efgh
Pre-read: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2b3c4d5e6f/view

Thanks — Dylan, fyi on the ask; I'll hand off technical details to you in the call.

Cheers,
Marissa
(attachment: redwood_dedicated_primer.pdf)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Müller <anna.mueller@safetyfirst.de>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Reyes <carlos.reyes@safetyfirst.de>
Date: Thu, 1 Apr 2027 14:42:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up & next steps from today

Hi all — thanks for the invite, looking forward to the call on Apr 6. A couple quick notes from the sizing side before we meet: 

- If you can share: sample 24h qps histogram (per-minute or per-5-min), percentiles for request token lengths, and expected model variants per route, that will let us produce a recommended starting config (gpu types, #replicas, batching thresholds).
- For initial estimation, using your numbers (120 interactive conc, +30 batch) with Llama-3-70B quantized, expect we may recommend 6–8 A100-equivalent replicas with continuous batching and prefix caching to hit p95 < 250ms — but we'll validate on the data.
- Also confirm whether you need HSM/KMS integration for key management during the Dedicated deployment.

I'll prepare a short sizing worksheet before the call (will upload to the Drive link Marissa shared).

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Principal Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
(dylan.brooks@redwood.ai)
